reviews.title: Mic Cover
reviews.comment: In re the cover- It's larger than the mic. Once over the mic, I cut a slit so the usb cable could plug in. No problem. Seems the volume wasn't affected, so its function is fine- per my friends. I think I got a good value- buying the mic "like new" paid for the cover.  Decent quality, and the look is cool- a mic. Seems it will last.
